title: DIP: Unsupervised Dense In-Context Post-Training of Visual Representations
mechanism: Unsupervised post-training of a pretrained ViT on automatically generated pseudo in-context tasks (diffusion model + encoder) so dense features work better for kNN / in-context segmentation.
evidence: R: beats the initial encoder and prior methods on in-context scene understanding; under 9 h on one A100.
adaptation: Post-train DINOv2-B on the 12k EL pool (1 channel replicated) and use it as the memory feature for the retrieval head and as matcher for SAM2/DINO labellers.
min_experiment: Retrieval-head experiment with DIP-post-trained DINOv2 vs plain DINOv2 memory; metric out-of-fold mIoU_rob and inactive IoU; kill if no gain over plain DINOv2 memory.
prior_overlap: Partial: MIM and DDeP pool pretraining on ResNet-34 were n.d.; DIP is a ViT with an in-context objective, not tested.
